### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Issue Number: close #39614

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

We can get cpu monitor by cgroup or syscall. but it has a shortcoming which change frequently. It is bad for scheduler to do a robust schedule. so that we need to a exponential moving average cpu monitor.

issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

In tidb, we cannot get the cpu usage by using api. so we need to add it. We alse need to be concrerned at the docker and physical machine. because CPU values will be disturbed. we need to smooth it.

review_comments: Is this too long for test?
It is not the main problem. because this is a test only for this part. so this test cache can be used for a long time.
CPU Observer will create a gorotine to collect the cpu monitor info. When TiDB exit, we need to notice this gorotine to exit.
This CPU Observer goroutine is not in TiDB process？
In TiDB process, it will be started by resource manage.
If this NumCPU is cgroup or contaner awarness?
if c.Quota <= is true, it should be in physical machine. it just return NumCPU.
